notes.subject: כְּיוֹם מוֹעֵד
notes.rationale: Ambiguous: 'as on the day of an appointed feast' — a shout of joy — versus 'as on the day of battle assembly'; most render feast, the bitter irony of festival noise now cries of destruction.

notes.subject: נָאַר
notes.rationale: Rare verb; 'abhorred/spurned' — a near-synonym of זנח in the parallel line, rendered with distinct Gĩkũyũ verbs to keep the parallelism.

notes.subject: זנח/נאר
notes.rationale: Paired synonyms in parallel couplets — rejected/abhorred — reinforcing the abandonment of altar and sanctuary; parallelism kept in Gĩkũyũ.

translation: Adonai nĩarehetie mbirarũ yake, nĩanenyetie hema yake theru; nĩatĩĩirie mĩgongo ya macabari make muoko-inĩ wa mũmenethani; nĩmahonire mũgambo hema-inĩ ya Yahwe ta ũmũthĩ wa kĩrore kĩgeranio.
